subject.title: [Bug]: qqbot + ollama + local model: qwen3.5:27b report: error Embedded agent failed before reply: LLM request failed: network connection was interrupted

question: Should diagnostic stuck-session recovery abort long silent local Ollama/QQBot model calls before the configured provider timeout, or should local-provider progress and timeout settings extend that recovery window?
rationale: The earlier QQBot response watchdog now honors provider timeouts, while duplicate follow-up logs and current diagnostics code show the remaining cutoff can come from recovery of silent model calls; changing that behavior affects both slow local models and protection from genuinely wedged sessions.

options.title: Extend local-provider recovery window
options.body: Use explicit local provider timeout/progress signals to keep diagnostics recovery from aborting valid long-running local model calls early.

options.title: Keep current recovery window
options.body: Preserve bounded stuck-session recovery and ask for stronger live evidence or user configuration before changing defaults.

options.title: Add explicit recovery policy
options.body: Expose a narrow documented operator policy for long local model calls instead of changing default recovery behavior for all sessions.

recommendation.title: Extend local-provider recovery window
recommendation.body: Use explicit local provider timeout/progress signals to keep diagnostics recovery from aborting valid long-running local model calls early.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent broad AI/runtime refactors and adjacent watchdog-locality work make steipete the best available owner for the cross-cutting recovery policy choice.
